DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒をお持ちですね。発送方法で重視したい点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have an envelope. Is there anything you particularly need from the shipping method?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 提出した書類の内容が後でわかるようにしたいです。追跡番号があれば、どの書類を入れたかまで証明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 追跡番号が封筒に入れた書類の内容まで証明するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to be able to know later which documents I submitted. Does a tracking number prove exactly which documents were inside?
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a tracking number also proves which documents were inside the envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 荷物や郵便の移動を確認する追跡と、封筒の中身についての証明は分けて考える必要があります。提出先は何を求めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tracking the movement of mail or parcels and proving an envelope's contents need to be considered separately. What does the recipient require?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 案内には「提出した資料の控えを保管」とあります。配達された記録さえあれば、資料の控えはいらないと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 資料控え保管の案内を配達記録で代替できると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The instructions say to keep copies of the materials submitted. I thought a delivery record meant I wouldn't need copies of the materials.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought a delivery record could replace the instruction to keep copies of the materials. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その文面では資料の控えが求められていますね。こちらで提出先の条件を置き換えることはできません。封はもうされていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: That wording asks for copies of the materials. We can't replace the recipient's requirements here. Have you already sealed it?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。原本しか持ってきていないので、いったん持ち帰って、自分の控えを残してからにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未封で原本しかないため自分の控えを残すべく持ち帰ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I've brought only the originals, so I'd like to take them home for now and keep my own copies first.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to take the unsealed originals home because you need to keep your own copies. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。発送はまだ受け付けていません。提出先に、配達の記録も必要か確認するご予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. We haven't accepted it for mailing yet. Are you planning to ask the recipient whether a delivery record is also required?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。資料の控えとは別に、受け取られたことをどの形で残す必要があるか聞きます。追跡だけで足りると決めないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 資料控えとは別に必要な受領記録の形式を提出先へ尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Separately from the material copies, I'll ask what form of proof of receipt needs to be retained. I won't assume tracking alone is enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll ask the recipient what form of receipt record is required, separately from material copies. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その条件がわかれば、取扱方法と料金を比べてご案内できます。今日の封筒はご自身でお持ち帰りになりますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once those conditions are known, we can compare handling methods and fees. You'll take today's envelope home yourself, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 封をしないまま持ち帰ります。控えと必要な記録を確かめてから、発送の方法を選びに来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未封のまま持ち帰り控えと記録条件の確認後に発送方法を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take it home unsealed. I'll come back to choose a mailing method after checking the copies and required records.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll take it home unsealed and choose a mailing method after checking copy and record requirements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本日はお預かりせず、方法の相談までといたします。書類のお忘れ物がないよう、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Today we won't take the envelope; we'll limit this to discussing methods. Please take care not to leave any documents behind.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 新しい口座についてのご相談ですね。何に使うご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about a new account. What do you plan to use it for?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 給与の受取りに使いたいです。会社から口座情報の提出期限を言われていますが、その日までに必ず作れるとは考えない方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与口座情報の提出期限があっても必ず開設できると考えない方がよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to receive my salary. My company has set a deadline for submitting account details. Should I avoid assuming it can definitely be opened by then?
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you shouldn't assume a salary account can definitely be opened despite a deadline to submit details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 申込み後に確認があるため、会社の期限だけで開設時期を約束することはできません。お持ちの確認書類を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are checks after application, so we can't promise an opening date based only on the company's deadline. Please tell me which verification documents you have.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 在留カードと勤務先の書類があります。ただ、会社の書類は名前の一部が省略されていて、同じ表記ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 在留カードと勤務先書類を持ち会社書類の氏名が一部省略されていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have my residence card and employment documents. But part of my name is abbreviated on the company document, so the spelling isn't identical.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have a residence card and work documents, but the company document abbreviates part of your name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 相違がある箇所はそのまま担当へ示してください。ご自身で書類を直さず、追加の確認が必要か伺いましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Show the differing parts to the person in charge as they are. Don't alter the documents yourself; let's ask whether additional verification is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 省略された部分に印を付けたメモを別紙に作ります。原本は書き換えず、どの表記で申し込むか担当に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 原本を直さず別紙で氏名差を示し申込表記を担当へ確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll make a separate note marking the abbreviated part. I won't rewrite the original, and I'd like to ask the person in charge which version of my name to apply with.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll show the name difference on a separate sheet without altering originals and ask which name form to use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。給与の振込先として会社が求める条件も、こちらの審査とは別です。会社の指定は確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Your company's requirements for a salary payment account are also separate from our screening. Have you checked what the company specifies?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 口座の種類や名義の伝え方までは聞けていません。開設を急がせるより、会社に必要な情報と期限に間に合わない場合の連絡先を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社へ口座条件と期限に遅れる場合の連絡先を確認し審査を急がせないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I haven't asked about the account type or how to provide the account name. Rather than urging you to open it faster, I'll ask the company what information it needs and whom to contact if I miss the deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll ask the company about account requirements and whom to contact if late, rather than rush the screening. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当には、書類の表記と申込みの流れを確認したいとおつなぎします。今日は署名まで進めたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll connect you to the person in charge to check the document wording and application process. Do you want to proceed as far as signing today?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず説明を聞きます。読めない箇所や名前の扱いを確認してから署名し、今日中にできる前提では会社へ返事をしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 氏名扱いと読めない条項を説明後に署名し即日開設前提で会社へ返事しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll listen to the explanation first. I'll sign after checking any unreadable sections and how my name is handled. I won't reply to my company on the assumption it can be done today.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll sign after explanations of unreadable terms and name handling, and won't tell the company opening is assumed today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは申込み相談の担当へご案内します。開設の可否と時期は確認後のご案内になります。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll guide you to the application adviser. Whether and when the account can be opened will be explained after the checks. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その住まいの模型について、お尋ねになりたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you'd like to ask about that model of a home?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昔の家がそのままここに移されたのかと思いましたが、説明に「復元」とあります。本物が残っているという意味ではないのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 復元模型を昔の家そのものと思ったが違うのか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought an old house had been moved here intact, but the description says reconstruction. Doesn't that mean the original remains?
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you thought the reconstructed model was the actual old house and ask whether that's wrong. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この展示は、資料をもとに作った模型です。昔の建物そのものを移したという説明ではありません。どの点を詳しく知りたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This exhibit is a model made from historical materials. It doesn't say the old building itself was moved here. What would you like to know more about?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 人が暮らした様子を知りたいです。ただ、模型の細部まで全部わかっていたのか、推測の部分もあるのかを分けて読みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 暮らしの展示で資料でわかる部分と推測部分を分けて読みたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to know how people lived. But I'd like to distinguish whether every detail of the model was known or whether some parts are conjecture.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to distinguish what the materials establish from conjecture in the display of past life. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この解説では、資料で確かめた部分と、想定して作った部分を別の色で示しています。まず凡例をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: This commentary uses different colors for parts confirmed by the materials and parts made on assumptions. Please look at the legend first.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 色の意味を読んでから見ます。あとで友人に説明したいので、この凡例と模型を一緒に写真へ入れてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 色の凡例を読んだ上で模型と凡例を一緒に撮影できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll read the color meanings before looking. I'd like to explain it to a friend later. May I include the legend and model together in a photo?
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Read the color legend and ask whether you can photograph it together with the model. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この区域の表示では模型の撮影は可能です。ただ、隣の原資料の展示区域には撮影禁止の表示があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The signs in this area permit photographing the model. But the neighboring area displaying original materials has photography prohibition signs.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 模型の撮影許可を、隣の展示にも当てはめないようにします。両方が写り込む位置では撮らず、模型の側だけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 模型の撮影可を隣の禁止区域へ広げず模型側だけを撮ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't apply the model's permission to the neighboring exhibit. I won't take a photo from a position that includes both; I'll photograph only the model side.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you won't extend model photography permission to the prohibited area next door and will photograph only the model side. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかの方や禁止区域が入らない位置を選んでください。バッグが展示台に当たらないよう、前に抱えてご覧いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Choose a position without other people or the prohibited area in the frame. Could you hold your bag in front while looking so it doesn't hit the display stand?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: バッグを前に持ち、展示台から離れて見ます。写真を見せるときも、昔の実物ではなく資料に基づく模型だと説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: バッグを前で持ち展示台から離れ写真は実物でなく模型と説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll hold my bag in front and look from a distance from the stand. When showing the photo, I'll explain that it's a model based on historical materials, not the old original.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll hold your bag in front, stay away from the stand, and explain the photo shows a model rather than the original. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 模型と原資料の違いを意識してご覧ください。次の区域ではまた表示を確かめてください。どうぞごゆっくり。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Keep the distinction between the model and original materials in mind. Check the signs again in the next area. Please take your time.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 入浴の前に、必要なものをご案内しましょうか。タオルはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: Shall I explain what you'll need before bathing? Do you have a towel?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 持っていません。入口に置いてあるタオルを見ましたが、持ち帰れるものと借りるものを見分けられません。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: タオルがなく入口の販売品と貸出品を区別したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: No. I saw towels at the entrance, but can't distinguish those I can take home from those I borrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have no towel and want to distinguish the ones for sale and loan at the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この案内では、袋入りのものが販売用、別のかごのものが貸出用です。どちらを希望されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: According to this guide, the bagged ones are for sale, and those in the other basket are for loan. Which would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今回は借りたいです。貸出料に含まれているから持ち帰ってよい、という意味ではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 借りるタオルを選び貸出料が持帰り許可を意味しないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to borrow one this time. Paying the loan fee doesn't mean I can take it home, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose a borrowed towel and confirm the loan fee doesn't permit taking it home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 貸出品はご利用後にご返却ください。返却口は受付横にあり、未使用品のかごとは分かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please return borrowed items after use. The return point is beside reception, separate from the basket of unused items.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 使ったものを最初のかごへ戻さず、受付横の返却口へ入れます。浴室へ入る前に、友人へ中の様子を写真で送ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 使用済みは返却口へ入れると述べ浴室の写真を友人へ送れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll put the used one in the return point beside reception, rather than the first basket. Before entering the bathing room, may I send a friend a photo of the inside?
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say used towels go in the return point and ask whether you can send a friend a photo of the bathing room. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 浴室内は撮影禁止という掲示があります。ほかの方が写らなくても、浴室の写真は撮らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: There's a notice prohibiting photography inside the bathing room. Please don't photograph it even if no other people appear.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 誰も写らなければよいと思っていました。浴室では携帯を出さず、友人には外で文章で連絡してから入ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 無人なら撮影可という理解を改め浴室で携帯を出さず外で文章連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: I thought it was fine if nobody was in the photo. I won't take out my phone in the bathing room; I'll message my friend in writing outside before going in.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Correct your belief that an empty bathing room could be photographed; keep your phone away there and message outside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。携帯や貴重品の保管については、こちらのロッカーの説明をご覧ください。使い方で気になる点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. For storing your phone and valuables, please read these locker instructions. Is anything about their use unclear?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 鍵の返し方を受付で聞いてから使います。タオルの返却口も先に見ておき、帰るときに持ち出さないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 鍵の返し方を尋ねタオル返却口を先に見て持ち出しを防ぐと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask reception how to return the key before using it. I'll also locate the towel return point first, so I don't take the towel away when leaving.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll ask how to return the key and locate the towel return point first to avoid taking it away. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ロッカーと返却口の確認からご案内します。準備ができてからご利用ください。どうぞごゆっくり。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll start by showing you the lockers and return point. Please use the facilities once you're ready. Take your time.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの案内所に来られたのは、待ち合わせのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you come to this information center for help meeting someone?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人から「門の前にいる」と来ました。私も門の前ですが見当たらず、どちらかが場所を間違えたのかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 互いに門の前と連絡しているのに会えないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend messaged that they're in front of the gate. I'm in front of a gate too but can't find them. One of us may be at the wrong place.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help because you're both saying you're at a gate but can't meet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この境内には門が二つあります。お友達がいる門について、文字の見える写真などは届いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are two gates in these grounds. Have you received a photo of your friend's gate with readable wording or something similar?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 写真に掲示板が写っています。私は赤い掲示板の前ですが、友人の写真は白い案内板です。色が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の赤い掲示板と友人の写真の白い案内板の違いを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: Their photo shows a noticeboard. I'm in front of a red noticeboard, but the photo has a white information board. The colors differ.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between your red noticeboard and the white board in your friend's photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内図では白い案内板の門はこちらです。ただ、連絡せずに両方が動くと行き違うことがあります。どちらが動くか決められますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: The map places the gate with the white board here. But if both move without contacting each other, you could miss each other. Can you decide who will move?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私がここで待ち、友人に来てもらう案を送ります。「赤い掲示板のある門で待つ」と書けば、門だけと言うより伝わりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分は赤い掲示板の門で待ち友人に来てもらう案を送ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll send a plan for me to wait here and my friend to come. Saying I'll wait at the gate with the red noticeboard should be clearer than just gate.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll send a plan to wait at the red-board gate and have your friend come. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相手がその案でよいと返事をするまで、決まったとは考えずに待ちましょう。今立っている通り道は空けていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: Until they reply agreeing to that plan, don't assume it's settled; wait. Could you clear the path where you're standing now?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 門を出入りする人の邪魔にならないよう、掲示板の横へ寄ります。待つ場所を少しずらすことも友人に書き添えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通行を空け掲示板横へ寄り友人にも待機位置の変更を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll move beside the noticeboard so I don't obstruct people using the gate. I'll also tell my friend I'm shifting my waiting spot slightly.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Clear the path, move beside the board, and tell your friend about the waiting position change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 横へ寄っても掲示板は見えますね。返信が来る前に移動する必要が出たら、どうなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can still see the board from the side. What will you do if you need to move before their reply arrives?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 黙って別の門へ向かわず、移動先を連絡して返事を待ちます。まずは今の場所で、友人がこちらへ来る案に同意するか確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 別の門へ無断で動かず移動案に相手が同意するか返事を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't silently head to another gate. I'll tell them where I'm moving and wait for a reply. First, I'll stay here and check whether they agree to come to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you won't move to another gate without notice and will await agreement to the movement plan. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では赤い掲示板の横で連絡をお待ちください。門の通行を空けていただきありがとうございます。無事に合流できますように。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then wait for contact beside the red noticeboard. Thank you for keeping the gate passage clear. I hope you meet up safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書の番号札をお持ちですね。今日は何の手続きをお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a queue ticket for certificates. What procedure are you planning today?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 別の市から引っ越したので、最初に新住所の証明を取ろうとしました。住所を届ける手続きは、まだここではしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 新住所証明を先に取ろうとし住所届出はまだしていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've moved from another city, so I first tried to obtain proof of my new address. I haven't registered the address here yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you tried to obtain new-address proof first but haven't registered the address yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 証明書の交付と住所の届出は別の用件です。今の状況を住所の担当へ確認しましょう。以前の役所で受け取ったものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: Issuing a certificate and registering an address are separate matters. Let's check your situation with the address staff. Did you receive anything from your previous municipal office?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前の役所から受け取った書類を持っています。名前を正しく読めないので、証明の申請に使う書類だと決めてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前の役所の読めない書類を証明申請用と決めたが用途確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have documents from the previous office. I couldn't read the name correctly, so assumed they were for the certificate application.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you assumed unreadable documents from the previous office were for a certificate and ask to check their use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その書類の用途も担当に確認します。ご本人と現在の住所について、ほかに示せるものはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll ask the staff about the documents' purpose too. Do you have anything else to show your identity and current address?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 在留カードと、新しい住まいの住所メモがあります。これで十分と決めず、不足するものと届出の期限も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 在留カードと新住所メモを持ち必要物の不足と届出期限を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have my residence card and a note of the new home's address. I don't want to assume that's enough; I'd like to ask what is missing and the registration deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your residence card and new-address note and ask what's missing and the registration deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要なものと期限はご本人の状況を確認してご案内します。今の証明書の番号札は、担当が確認するまで重複して取り直さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll explain the requirements and deadline after checking your situation. Don't take another overlapping certificate queue ticket until the staff checks the current one.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 新しい番号札を勝手に取らず、この札を見せて扱いを聞きます。先に住所の届出について相談する、という順番でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号札を勝手に取り直さず現在の札の扱いを聞き住所相談を先に頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't take a new ticket on my own. I'll show this one and ask how it's handled. Please arrange for me to ask about address registration first.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Don't take another ticket on your own; ask how the current one is handled and request address advice first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 住所の担当へおつなぎします。届出後に必要な証明についても、その場で次の窓口を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll connect you to the address staff. You can also check the next counter there for any certificate needed after registration.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に今の住所の届出と持参書類を確認し、その後でどの証明を申請するか決めます。札を取っただけで手続き済みとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所届出と書類を先に確認し証明は後で決め番号札取得を手続完了とみなさないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: First I'll check registering my current address and the documents I brought, then decide which certificate to apply for. I won't think taking a ticket means the procedure is complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll check address registration and documents first, decide the certificate later, and not treat a queue ticket as completion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ではこの番号札と書類をお持ちのまま、住所相談の担当へどうぞ。お気をつけてお進みください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then take this queue ticket and documents to the address adviser. Please proceed carefully. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約票を見ながらの変更相談ですね。どの予定が難しくなりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about changes while looking at your appointment slip. Which arrangement has become difficult?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事が入って、今の予約日に来られません。診察だけなら次の週へ変えられるかと思って相談に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事で現予約日に来られず診察だけだと思って翌週への変更を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: Work has come up, so I can't attend on the booked day. I came to ask about moving it to the following week, thinking it was just a consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say work prevents attendance and you want to move to next week, having thought it was consultation only. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約票には診察のほかに検査の記載があります。検査も同じ日に受ける予定だとご存じでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: The slip lists a test as well as a consultation. Did you know you were scheduled for both the same day?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 診察の時刻しか見ていませんでした。検査もあるなら、診察だけを動かしてよいとは決めず、両方の予定を確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 検査を見落としていたため診察だけ動かさず両方の予定確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only looked at the consultation time. If there's a test too, don't assume only the consultation can move; please check both arrangements.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you overlooked the test and ask to check both instead of moving only the consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 両方の担当に確認します。この準備の案内も一緒に受け取ったものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check with both departments. Did you receive this preparation guide together with it too?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。検査の前について書かれていますが、予約が変われば案内の日付も変わるのか聞きたいです。自分で日付を書き換えないでおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 準備案内の適用日も変わるか尋ね自分で日付を書き換えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. It's about before the test. I'd like to ask whether the date the guide applies to changes with the appointment. I won't rewrite the date myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether the preparation guide's applicable date also changes and say you won't rewrite it yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 準備の内容と適用日は、検査担当から確認してもらいましょう。症状や体調に変化はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's have the test staff confirm the preparation details and applicable date. Have your symptoms or physical condition changed?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今のところ変化はありません。ただ、変更しても大丈夫という判断まで自分ではできないので、その点も担当へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 体調は今のところ不変だが延期可能とは自己判断せず担当へ相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: No changes so far. But I can't decide for myself that postponing is all right, so I'll ask the staff about that too.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say your condition is unchanged so far, but you'll consult staff rather than judge postponement possible yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 変更できる候補と準備の説明を確認してから、新しい予定をお伝えします。元の予約を今消してしまわないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll give you the new arrangements after checking available alternatives and the preparation explanation. Don't delete the original appointment now.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新しい日時が確定するまでは元の予約票を残します。診察と検査の両方、それから準備の説明が更新されたかを聞き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新予定確定まで元の票を残し診察・検査・準備の更新を再確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll keep the original slip until the new date and time are confirmed. I'll ask again whether the consultation, test and preparation instructions have all been updated.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll retain the old slip until the new plan is confirmed and recheck updates for consultation, test and preparation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では担当への確認を進めます。今日はまだ変更確定ではありません。案内がそろってから次の予定を控えてください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we'll proceed with checking with the staff. The change isn't confirmed today yet. Once all the information is ready, note your next appointment. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 二つの水筒で迷われていますか。使い方で外せない条件はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you deciding between two drinking bottles? Are there any essential conditions for using them?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 毎日仕事へ持って行きます。容量は同じようですが、内側を洗う手間が少ない方を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事用で容量が同じように見える水筒を内側の洗いやすさで比べたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'll take it to work every day. Their capacities look similar, but I'd like the one whose inside takes less effort to wash.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to compare bottles for work whose capacities look similar by ease of washing inside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この二つは口の広さが違います。こちらの展示見本なら、ふたの部品も外した状態で比較できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: The openings differ in width. With these display samples, you can compare them with the lid parts removed too.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 細い方は手元のブラシが入りそうにありません。広い方でも、ふたに細かい部品があるなら、その洗い方を先に知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 細い口にブラシが入らず広い方のふた部品の洗い方も先に知りたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: My brush doesn't look as though it will fit the narrow one. Even with the wide one, if the lid has small parts, I'd like to know how to wash them first.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say your brush won't fit the narrow opening and ask first how to wash the wide one's lid parts too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 広い方の手入れ説明では、ふたの部品を分けて洗う図があります。付属品の欄も一緒に見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: The wide one's care instructions have a diagram showing the lid parts washed separately. Let's look at the included-accessory list too.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 図にあるブラシは、商品に付いていますか。説明に描いてあるだけなら、買った後で足りないと気づきそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 図のブラシが付属品か単なる説明図か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: Is the brush in the diagram included with the product? If it's just drawn as an explanation, I might discover it's missing after buying.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether the diagram's brush is included or only illustrative. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この付属品一覧にブラシはありません。必要なら別に用意することになります。持ち運びの大きさも比較しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: The brush isn't on this accessory list. You'll need to get one separately if required. Would you also like to compare their carrying size?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。家のかばんの口が狭いので、広い方が入るか外寸をメモしたいです。展示見本を持ち帰る商品と間違えないようにもしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 狭いかばんに入る外寸を控え展示品と購入品を区別したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. My bag's opening is narrow, so I'd like to note the wide one's external dimensions to check it fits. I'd also like to avoid confusing the display sample with the product I take home.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Note external dimensions for a narrow bag and say you want to distinguish display and purchase items. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 寸法表示はこちらです。展示見本は売場に残し、購入する場合は箱入りの商品を選びます。今日は決めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here's the dimension label. Leave the display sample in the sales area and select a boxed product if buying. Will you decide today?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 寸法とブラシが付属しないという点を控えて、一度かばんと予算を確かめます。今日は見本を戻し、箱入りの商品もまだ買いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 寸法とブラシ別用意を控えかばんと予算を確認するため今日は買わないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll note the dimensions and that the brush isn't included, then check my bag and budget. I'll return the sample today and won't buy the boxed product yet either.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Note dimensions and the need for a separate brush, and say you won't buy today while checking bag and budget. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 見本はこちらでお戻しします。手入れと寸法を確認してからご検討ください。またお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll put the sample back. Please consider it after checking care and dimensions. We look forward to seeing you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: チェックイン前に、予約内容を読み合わせましょうか。確認したい点を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-01.translation: Shall we read through the booking before check-in? Tell me what you'd like to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二日間の滞在と書いてあるので二泊だと思っていましたが、確認画面では一泊です。私の読み違いでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二日間を二泊と思ったが一泊表示であると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says a two-day stay, so I thought two nights, but the confirmation screen says one night. Did I misread it?
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about having read two days as two nights despite a one-night display. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この予約は到着日の翌日が出発日で、一泊です。二つの日にまたがることと二泊することは違います。ご希望の出発日はいつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: Under this booking, you depart the day after arrival, so it is one night. Spanning two dates differs from staying two nights. When would you like to depart?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 予約の出発日より、さらに翌日まで泊まるつもりでした。今の予約が二泊に変わったわけではないと理解しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本来はさらに翌日出発したいが現予約は二泊でないと理解したことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd intended to stay until the day after the booked departure date. I understand the current booking hasn't become two nights.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you intended to depart one day later but understand the current booking isn't two nights. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 追加の一泊は空室と条件を照会します。空いていることや同じ部屋を使えることは、まだ確定していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll inquire about availability and conditions for another night. Neither availability nor staying in the same room is confirmed yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ部屋に続けて泊まれるかも調べてください。別の部屋になるなら、移動が必要かを聞いてから延ばすか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同室延泊の可否と部屋移動の有無を調べ結果後に延泊判断したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please check whether I can continue in the same room too. If it would be another room, I'll ask whether moving is necessary before deciding to extend.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check same-room extension and any room move before you decide based on the result. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 空室のほか、部屋移動と追加料金も確認します。現在の一泊には朝食の記載がありますが、そこも確かめますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check a room move and extra charges as well as availability. The current one-night booking lists breakfast; would you like to check that too?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。今の予約で朝食が付くのはどの朝かを示してください。延泊できても、朝食まで自動で増えるとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現予約の朝食対象朝を示してもらい延泊時の自動追加は想定しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Please show which morning has breakfast under the current booking. Even if I extend, I won't assume breakfast automatically increases too.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask which morning the current breakfast applies to and say you won't assume automatic extra breakfast with extension. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予約に含まれる朝と、延泊した場合の条件を分けてご案内します。回答を待つ間は、元の予約を取り消さずにおきますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll explain the included morning separately from extension conditions. While awaiting a reply, we'll leave the original booking uncanceled.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 元の一泊は残してください。空室、部屋移動、追加の総額と朝食条件がわかってから、延泊を申し込むか返事をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元の一泊を残し空室・移動・追加総額・朝食条件の確認後に延泊を判断すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please retain the original one night. I'll reply about applying for an extension after I know availability, a room move, the total extra cost and breakfast conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Retain the original night and decide after checking availability, moving, total extra cost and breakfast conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 一泊の予約を維持したまま照会いたします。追加はまだ確定していませんので、こちらで回答をお待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll inquire while maintaining the one-night booking. The addition isn't confirmed yet, so please wait here for a reply. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 上映の案内をご覧ですか。見たい展示があれば伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at the screening information? Let me know if there's an exhibit you'd like to see.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この画面に餌を与える様子が映っているので、今ここで実演しているのかと思いました。見に行ける場所を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給餌映像を現在の実演と思い見に行ける場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: This screen shows feeding, so I thought it was being demonstrated here now. I'd like to know where I can go to see it.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you mistook feeding footage for a current demonstration and ask where to see it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この画面は録画した解説映像です。現在その作業を行っている場所を示しているわけではありません。見たいのは映像ですか、職員の説明ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: This screen is a recorded explanatory video. It doesn't show where that work is taking place now. Would you like the video or a staff explanation?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 職員の説明を聞きたいです。画面と同じ場面が見られるとは限らないので、今案内されている説明の内容を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 映像と同じ実演を期待せず今の職員解説の内容を知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to hear the staff explanation. I may not see the same scene as on screen, so I'd like to know the content of the explanation currently offered.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to know today's staff explanation content without expecting the same live scene as the video. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本日の掲示では、展示模型を使った解説を予定しています。生き物へ餌を与える参加型の案内ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: Today's notice schedules an explanation using an exhibit model. It isn't a participatory activity feeding live creatures.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持っている食べ物を使う催しではないのですね。自分で何か与えようとせず、模型の解説を聞く方にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持参の食べ物を使う催しでなく勝手に与えず模型解説を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: So it isn't an event using the food I brought. I won't try feeding anything myself; I'll choose to listen to the model explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it isn't an event using your own food, you won't feed anything yourself, and you'll choose the model explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 模型の解説場所はこの案内にあります。少し立って聞く形ですが、長く立つことは大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: The model explanation location is in this guide. You'll stand for a little while; is standing for a long time all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 長くは立っていられません。途中からでも後ろで聞けるか、座って見られる録画の方に切り替えられるかを知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 長時間立てないため後方で聞く場所と座れる録画への切替を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can't stand for long. I'd like to know whether I can listen at the back even partway through, or switch to the recorded video where I can sit.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Because you can't stand long, ask about listening at the back and switching to a seated recording. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通路を空けて後方で聞く場所と、録画の前の座席を案内できます。撮影については、解説中は撮影しないという表示があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can show you a place at the back that leaves the path clear and the seats in front of the recording. There's a sign saying no photography during the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 解説中は撮らず、疲れたら途中で無理せず録画の席へ移ります。実演を見たと勘違いしないよう、今日見た内容も分けて覚えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 解説中は撮らず疲れたら録画席へ移り実演と録画を区別して見学すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't photograph during the explanation. If tired, I'll move to the recording seats partway through without pushing myself. I'll keep today's different viewing experiences distinct so I don't mistake them for seeing a live demonstration.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Don't photograph the explanation, move to recording seats if tired, and distinguish a demonstration from a recording. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では模型の解説場所と録画の座席を先にお示しします。ご自分のペースでご覧ください。どうぞお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll first show you the model explanation location and recording seats. Please go at your own pace. Enjoy your visit.
